messages.text:
Created [software validation input](docs/design/inputs/DES-003-software-validation-input.md).

Proposes three stages:

1. Allocation drawings and straight-ray diagnostics now.
2. Active-surface crossings, material scenarios and field contracts next.
3. DD4hep/Geant4 geometry, transport and ACTS checks after approval.

Verified capabilities against official documentation; existing catalogue IDs cover the sources. Explicitly separates envelope crossings from hits, material budgets and demonstrated hermeticity.

Reported input-validation concerns in `study.py` to coordinator; no code changes.

Checks: whitespace clean; 22 session records valid. No detector runtime executed. Human owners, numerical targets and approval remain pending.

limitations: Only userMessage and agentMessage text retained; reasoning, tool arguments/results and private state excluded.
Conservative path, credential, email and URL redaction is not a privacy guarantee; review retained text.
Exposed operation counts are per retained turn; journal counts can describe the same invocations and must not be added.
